entity: 3I/ATLAS at 1665–1668 MHz: the band of the hydroxyl (OH) 18 cm main lines (rest 1665.4018 and 1667.3590 MHz) at the interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS (C/2025 N1), where MeerKAT detected the comet's OH absorption on 24 October 2025 (ATel #17473; Pisano, Smirnov, Ivchenko, Roth and Buchner) and OH absorption and emission in November (ATel #17499), where MeerKAT's BLUSE search set a 0.17 W limit over 900–1670 MHz, and where the archive's notebook (#1742 §7) holds thirteen comet-frame features in Green Bank coarse channel 7 (1665.53–1668.46 MHz, 2025-12-18), off the comet-frame OH lines (#1742 §7.5)

config.classes_note: Two classes, each sourced by the field B. (1) radio technosignature searches of 3I/ATLAS that include the band: B4 (card 4, the BLUSE search at 900–1670 MHz; the ATA at 1–9 GHz; the GBT at 1–12 GHz), B9 (ATel #17499); T names the Green Bank Telescope and the ATA. (2) spectral lines of comets in radio: B2, B7, B10. Aliases: the band's frequencies as the archive and the field write them (1665–1668 MHz, 1665/1667, 1.665–1.668 GHz), the molecule (hydroxyl; OH with a line word, since 'OH' alone is a common string), and the 18 cm wavelength. Admission by reading (§3.4): D where a deposit says something of the band at 3I/ATLAS (the OH detection, the thirteen, a search at the band); a sentence on hydroxyl elsewhere (the atmosphere, chemistry) or on 1667 MHz at another object is read and not admitted; O-class where a sentence applies an archive category to one of the two classes. The thirteen are the archive's own features at the band (#1742 §7); the comet's OH line, as an entity of its own, is a neighbour (the disambiguation).
